messages:
ana: Heads-up — planning to cut release/1.17 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Two quick clarifying q's before I nudge everyone:
- Who should actually create the release/* branch?
- Backport cutoff: are bugfix PRs still allowed up to RC, and features require explicit approval? Need to message the changelog owners.

ben: I can create the branch tomorrow if nobody else has strong preference. Our usual policy: bugfixes = until RC, features require eng lead + PM signoff and must be flagged in the PR.

chris: +1 to ben creating it. Also callout: infra-migrations or schema changes need a release lead signoff and a migration playbook PR. We try to avoid those after branch cut unless emergency.

ana: small correction — for backports we prefer cherrypicks that include the original commit message and the backport label `backport/1.17`. It helps automation.

ana: can you paste the git commands you use so I can add to the release checklist?

ben: sure — here's the minimal flow I use:
```
# create branch locally from main tip
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.17 origin/main
# push and create remote branch
git push -u origin release/1.17
```
after that I open a PR from release/1.17 -> main and add the `release-team` reviewer and `release/1.17` label.

chris: also add a quick CI smoke: run `./scripts/smoke-release.sh` and check perf dashboard for regressions before we lock the branch.

ana: good point. Who will be release lead? we need one to approve infra/migrations and to triage backport requests.

ana: @sana? you free tomorrow morning to take lead? :pray:

sana: I can take it friday morning (09:00 PT) — happy to own approvals and quick triage. Please cc me on backport PRs. :thumbsup:

ben: deploy-bot will post when the branch exists, I can create it at 09:00 PT and tag you, sana.

deploy-bot: branch release/1.17 created by ben at 2147002500. Protection rules applied: require PR reviews, CI green.

ana: awesome, thanks ben + sana. I'll send a short changelog nudge to authors now and add the git snippet + backport label guidance to the release checklist.

chris: two extra notes: 1) if a PR targets main after the cut, please add `needs-backport` label and ping release lead, 2) for any backports that change public API, require tech-writing signoff for changelog entries.

ana: noted. I'll update the checklist and post the final branch link in #eng-releases once ben's done.

ben: will do. tagging follow-ups in the PR.

sana: I'll be online at cut time for quick approvals and any emergency backports.

ana: thanks everyone — closing loop once branch shows up. :white_check_mark:
